scope: source-pinned planning rules, not current runtime capabilities or scientific proof
authority: Actual registered version/parser overrides historical observations and latest public manuals. Defaults need current-source verification.

rules.execution_status: NO_STUDIO_ADAPTER; authoring/reference guidance cannot become ready-to-submit route
basic: actual train and explicit validation/heldout assets
NEP4 regular energy model only for reliable baseline
explicit source-compatible architecture/cutoffs and target consumer
readiness_hazards: --val-fraction is reserved/unused; missing test.xyz disables validation, no promised automatic10% split
--restart loads weights, not full Adam state
generation maps default epoch count; population does not control Adam; unsupported native keys may be parsed but unused
ordinary NEP4 only; qNEP virial known failed, charge/BEC/dipole/polar training not implemented
explicit MD targets reject second hidden layer; GPU-Sampling target rejects extra invariant layouts
default target=torchnep only persistence, not native consumer validation
native and TorchNEP ZBL syntax/defaults differ; do not transfer entire nep.in unchanged
same-name PyPI/latest or older branch docs are not this pinned0.1.0 lineage
